churches.assessment: St. John's Episcopal Church on Lafayette Square at 16th and H Street NW is the historic Greek Revival church (1816, designed by Benjamin Henry Latrobe) directly across from the White House. Known as the "Church of the Presidents" — every sitting president since James Madison has attended at least once. Pew 54 is the official President's Pew. Designated a National Historic Landmark in 1960. Current rector is Rev. Robert W. Fisher. Institutionally part of TEC (Diocese of Washington), which since the 2003 General Convention has departed from biblical authority on sexual ethics and ordains women as bishops since 1989. Per MOOP rubric this is RED at the denominational level; included for situational awareness given its national ceremonial role — presidents from every administration visit, even if rarely as a regular spiritual home.

churches.assessment: St. Martin's Episcopal Church in Houston is the largest Episcopal congregation in the United States by membership and attendance. The Bush family — George H.W. and Barbara Bush — joined St. Martin's after moving from Midland in 1959, raised their five children there (including future president George W. Bush), and returned in 1993 upon leaving the White House. President George H.W. Bush's 2018 funeral was held at St. Martin's. Rev. Russell Levenson Jr. served as rector 2007-2024, and Rev. Dane Boston (formerly Dean of Trinity Episcopal Cathedral, Columbia SC) was installed in 2025. Institutionally TEC has fully departed from biblical authority on sexual ethics since 2003, ordains women as bishops since 1989, and performs same-sex marriages. St. Martin's under Levenson positioned itself as the more traditional mediating wing of TEC, but remained in TEC rather than departing to ACNA. Per MOOP rubric this is RED at the denominational level; included for situational awareness about the Bush family church.
